html:
On 4 March 1938 American drillers struck oil in commercial quantities at well number 7 in Dammam, near the Gulf coast of eastern Saudi Arabia. It was the first commercial oil find in the kingdom.

The Standard Oil Company of California had won a concession from Ibn Saud in 1933, after oil was found in nearby Bahrain. Six earlier wells disappointed. The geologist Max Steineke urged the team to drill deeper, and well 7 struck oil at about 1,440 metres. Nicknamed Prosperity Well, it went on pumping for decades.

The find led to the company that became Saudi Aramco, and to the discovery of Ghawar, the largest oil field in the world, in 1948. The poor desert kingdom became one of the richest states on earth.
sum: On 4 March 1938 American drillers struck oil in commercial quantities at well number 7 in Dammam, near the Gulf coast of eastern Saudi Arabia. It was the first commercial oil find in the kingdom.
